decision_source.context: Acceptance of the reviewed local inference reference pattern after clarification of operator versus caller.

scope: Alch/DomainSpec local inference reference pattern; generated Node bundle and documented protocol, with deterministic fixtures

role_clarification.operator: Configures the engine, bindings, aliases and limits.
role_clarification.caller: Requests inference through the exposed API.
role_clarification.engine: Executes the model or reference fixture.
role_clarification.overlap: One person or system may perform both operator and caller roles.

verification_boundary: All 48 source bindings and 865 bundle files matched before recording acceptance. Subsequent Craft and planning edits record this decision; they do not alter the accepted bundle or rewrite historical test evidence.
